scientific_integrity: The universal statements are established by a fully given symbolic kernel expansion and elementary complex-root argument. A companion standard-library checker reproduces 414 finite consistency configurations but is not a replacement for proof. General kernel formulas and closely related two-term results are credited; independent review and publication-priority determination remain outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Sharp zero-free phase and exact scalar-zero count hold for real coefficients \(a,b\) in the functional \(f+af\prime+bf\prime\prime\) on the weighted upper half-plane with \(\alpha>-1\). The count is of scalar zero fibres rather than isolated point pairs. Complex coefficients and other domains remain unclassified; historical priority under alternate terminology may remain unresolved.
title: Sharp zero-free phase boundary for real three-term weighted Bergman jets
